They used surface clues such as “curved” and “flat,” and correctly predicted flat-faced objects would slide in both unaided attempts. Anika first said only balls can roll; after looking at a bottle’s curved side, they changed this prediction and said it might roll. At home, ask them to sort safe household objects by whether they roll, slide, or stack, and explain the surface clue.
